relationship_support: Chain grouping (subtask-to-parent-chain via source_task_id/subtask_index/chain_length): AVAILABLE. known_limitations: No memory-unit layer exists at all -- no memory_id, session_id, or timestamp field anywhere in the source (full scan, 701 records). Almost all Phase 3.2-C/D retrieval, evidence, and provenance/lineage metrics are NOT_ATTEMPTABLE as a direct consequence -- see mambench_compatibility.json.
No gold_evidence_ids field exists; EvaluatorReference-shaped objects built from this data would have no evidence-ID component.

Answer element type varies by config: dict (bundled_shopping), list (group_travel_planner), str (progressive_search, formal_reasoning_math, formal_reasoning_phys). The existing str-only exact-match ANSWER_CORRECTNESS metric works as-is only for the 3 str-typed configs (281/701 chains, 2081/4850 subtasks).
Code repo has no LICENSE file; code license status is UNKNOWN. Only the HuggingFace-hosted task/answer data itself carries an explicit CC-BY-4.0 license.
GitHub README states the code is a 'preview version...actively maintaining and improving' -- source itself flags non-final status.

Web-search environment's underlying retrieval corpus (encrypted, requires running download_embeddings_from_hf.py/decrypt_dataset.py) was not obtained -- only the progressive_search task questions/answers themselves were downloaded, not the corpus the environment would search at execution time.
Only one HuggingFace dataset snapshot was inspected (sha da1a37c8b19280e18627ca01cf368195a5e1d92e); ID/content stability across future revisions is UNKNOWN.
